how: Opened the public view-only Google Sheet 'Example Spreadsheet' (Google's Sheets API sample, 'Class Data') in the Sheets editor in headless Chrome, jumped to A1 and selected 6 rows x 5 columns with Shift+Arrow, Cmd+C.
notes: Real Sheets copy (view-only sheet), 6x5 cells of plain strings: <meta charset='utf-8'><google-sheets-html-origin><style> td rules</style><table xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" ... data-sheets-root="1" data-sheets-baot="1"><colgroup>... plain <td>s. No <b docs-internal-guid> wrapper, and no data-sheets-value/formula attributes on this view-only copy. Plain text is TSV.
